description: This file defines the TraceModernizer class responsible for processing and modernizing trace data across different versions in the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for handling trace events, version upgrades, and error handling related to trace version compatibility.

classes.name: TraceVersionError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling unsupported trace versions.

classes.name: TraceModernizer
classes.description: Main class for modernizing and processing trace data across different versions.

methods.name: appendTrace
methods.description: Splits the trace string into lines and processes each event.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Returns an array of all ActionEntry objects collected.

methods.name: _pageEntry
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a PageEntry for a given pageId.

methods.name: _appendEvent
methods.description: Parses a line of trace data and appends the resulting events.

methods.name: _innerAppendEvent
methods.description: Processes individual trace events based on their type and updates internal state.

methods.name: _processedContextCreatedEvent
methods.description: Checks if the context creation event has been processed.

methods.name: _modernize
methods.description: Converts an event to the latest trace version by applying sequential modernization steps.

methods.name: _modernize_0_to_1
methods.description: Modernizes trace events from version 0 to version 1.

methods.name: _modernize_1_to_2
methods.description: Modernizes trace events from version 1 to version 2.

methods.name: _modernize_2_to_3
methods.description: Modernizes trace events from version 2 to version 3.

methods.name: _modernize_3_to_4
methods.description: Converts trace events from version 3 to version 4.

methods.name: _modernize_event_3_to_4
methods.description: Converts individual trace events from version 3 to 4.

methods.name: _modernize_4_to_5
methods.description: Converts trace events from version 4 to version 5.

methods.name: _modernize_event_4_to_5
methods.description: Converts individual trace events from version 4 to 5.

methods.name: _modernize_5_to_6
methods.description: Converts trace events from version 5 to 6, including handling console args.

methods.name: _modernize_6_to_7
methods.description: Converts trace events from version 6 to 7, adding context and step IDs.

methods.name: _modernize_7_to_8
methods.description: Converts trace events from version 7 to 8, updating stepId and title fields.
